rows.ARS:
Deep yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Sunblest
Exhibition name: Sunblest
rows.Origin:
Bred by Mathias Tantau, Jr. (1912 - 2006) (Germany, before 1970).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 1970 as 'Landora'.
rows.Bloom: Deep yellow. None to mild fragrance. 30 to 40 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, armed with thorns / prickles, upright. Glossy, light green foliage.

Height: 3' to 4¼' (90 to 130cm). Width: 2' (60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Notes: Fryer's Roses says Sunblest is probably the most successful yellow Hybrid Tea of recent years. This rose has superbly formed flowers of bright unfading yellow...
